title: A note on goal-based hierarchical RL
abstract: arXiv:2609.14605v1 Announce Type: new  Abstract: The agent-centric general value function (ACGVF) construction of   \citet{tasse2026goal} lets the agent make two decisions that are   normally imposed by the environment or agent designer: which goal to   pursue and when to declare a goal as finished (in addition to   choosing the action). This is a very general framework that   subsumes almost all prior work on reinforcement learning, control   and planning, as well as more general formalisms proposed in the   cognitive sciences. However, it assumes the environment is fully   observed, i.e., that the observation is a sufficient statistic. In   \citet{murphy2025rl}, a general agent design was proposed where the   policy is based on an internal belief state $z_t$ and an internal   goal; however, the goals were assumed to be externally provided. In   this note, we unify and extend these two approaches using the   formalism of hierarchical hidden Markov models (HHMM) \citep{murphy2001hhmm}.

translated_title: 关于基于目标的分层强化学习的注记
translated_abstract: tasse2026goal提出的以智能体为中心的广义价值函数（ACGVF）构建方法，让智能体能够做出通常由环境或智能体设计者强加的两个决策：追求哪个目标，以及何时宣布一个目标已经完成（除了选择动作之外）。这是一个非常通用的框架，几乎涵盖了强化学习、控制与规划领域的所有先前工作，以及认知科学中提出的更一般的形式化方法。然而，它假设环境是完全可观测的，即观测是一个充分统计量。在murphy2025rl中，提出了一种通用的智能体设计，其中策略基于内部信念状态 $z_t$ 和内部目标；然而，目标是假设由外部提供的。在本注记中，我们使用分层隐马尔可夫模型（HHMM）的形式化方法统一并扩展了这两种方法。
tldr: 本注记使用分层隐马尔可夫模型（HHMM）的形式化方法，统一并扩展了以智能体为中心的广义价值函数（ACGVF）框架与基于内部信念状态的智能体设计，使智能体能够在部分可观测环境中自主决定追求哪个目标以及何时宣布目标完成。
en_tdlr: This note unifies and extends the agent-centric general value function (ACGVF) framework and belief-state-based agent design using the formalism of hierarchical hidden Markov models (HHMM), enabling agents to autonomously decide which goal to pursue and when a goal is finished, even in partially observable environments.
